name: Thai Thai Melrose Restaurant
notes: All 4 photos were legible printed menu pages: Salads, Noodle (build-your-own, priced by protein choice), and Specialties (two pages, 66-70 and 56-60, merged into one section).

dishes.name: Papaya Salad
dishes.description: Shredded green papaya carrot, tomatoes, green bean mixed with Thai chili, lime juice, garlic and top with peanut. Tofu $14 / Shrimp $16.

dishes.name: Papaya Salad (Lao Style)
dishes.description: Shredded green papaya carrot, tomatoes, green bean, pickled crab, boiled fermented fish sauce mixed with thai chilli, lime juice, garlic

dishes.name: Glass Noodle Salad (Yam Woon Sen)
dishes.description: Clear glass noodle combined with ground chicken, shrimp, calamari, lime juice, fresh Thai chili, red onions, tomatoes, green onion and mint leaves.

dishes.name: Seafood Salad
dishes.description: Fresh shrimp, fish, scallop, calamari, mussel mixed with lime juice, cucumbers, fresh Thai chilli, red onions, tomatoes, green onion and mint leaves.

dishes.name: Larb (Choice of Chicken or Pork)
dishes.description: Minced chicken or pork tossed with spicy lime dressing, red onions, mint, dried chilli, green onion & homemade rice powder.

dishes.name: Spicy Grilled Pork Salad (Num Tok)
dishes.description: Grilled pork or beef tossed with spicy lime dressing, red onion, mint leaves, dried chilli and a touch of rice powder. Pork $17 / Beef $18.

dishes.name: Cucumber Salad
dishes.description: Fresh cucumber with vinegar dressing.

dishes.name: Pad Thai
dishes.description: Stir fried small rice noodles with egg, green onion, bean sprouts and ground peanuts aside.

dishes.name: Kee Moa (Spicy Noodle)
dishes.description: Stir fried flat rice noodles with egg, onion, bell pepper, chili and Thai basil.

dishes.name: Pad See-Ewe
dishes.description: Stir fried flat rice noodles with egg, carrot and broccoli / Chinese Broccoli.

dishes.name: Pad Woonsen
dishes.description: Stir fried glass noodle with egg, napa, onion, zucchini, snow peas, broccoli, bean sprout, cabbage, carrot and celery served in claypot.

dishes.name: Chow Mein Noodle
dishes.description: Stir fried egg and noodle with green & white onions, celery, cabbage, bean sprout, carrot, zucchini & broccoli.

dishes.name: Lard Nar
dishes.description: Stir fried flat noodle, broccoli / Chinese broccoli topped with Thai gravy sauce.

dishes.name: Kai Kua
dishes.description: Stir fried flat rice noodles with egg, green and white onion, bean sprouts, celery and carrot.

dishes.name: Spicy Mussels
dishes.description: New Zealand green mussels stir fried with onions, bell peppers, fresh ginger, carrots and Thai basil in our homemade chilli sauce.

dishes.name: Pad Kha Pow (Thai Style)
dishes.description: Choice of minced chicken or minced pork sauteed with Thai basil, Thai chilli, bell pepper, onion, garlic and green bean.

dishes.name: Tum Tard
dishes.description: Shredded green papaya, carrot, tomato, green bean mixed with Thai chili, lime juice, fresh garlic & peanut. Served with fried chicken wing, pork rind, fresh vegetable and hard boiled egg.

dishes.name: Nam Kao Tod
dishes.description: Sour pork sausage mixed with crispy rice, cilantro, shallot, green onion, ginger, mint leaves, peanut, lime juice, and dried chilli.

dishes.name: Northern Larb (Chicken or Pork)
dishes.description: Choice of minced chicken or minced pork tossed with Northern Thai spices dressing, mint leaves, cilantro, green onion, Vietnamese coriander, garlic and Kaffir lime leaves.

dishes.name: Ocean Seafood
dishes.description: Fresh calamari, shrimp, scallops, mussels, fish, carrots, onions, mushroom, bell pepper, and Thai basil in our special sauce.

dishes.name: Pad Ped Talay
dishes.description: Calamari, shrimp, scallops, mussels, fish, green bean, bell pepper, bamboo shoots and basil stir fried in a delicious red curry paste.

dishes.name: Panang Salmon
dishes.description: Salmon topped with panang curry sauce then served on bed of freshly steamed vegetable.

dishes.name: Cashews Salmon
dishes.description: Salmon filet topped with stir fried carrots, celery, onions, cashew nut and snow peas with Thai special sauce.

dishes.name: Ginger Perfect Fish
dishes.description: Steamed fish filet topped with fresh ginger, pineapple, mushroom, celery, onion, bell pepper, carrot and snow peas with our special sauce.
